thread:
maria.p: CI red: integration suite failing against hosted-api on all shards (streaming + auth + toolcall schema). noticed ~30 failing tests, looks like a combo of 401s and schema validation errors. anyone already looking?

ashok: saw the alert. not in a meeting, can grab logs. which pipeline/shard to start with?

ci-bot: AUTO-FAIL: nightly/integration/hosted-api (shards 0-4) — 5/5 shards failed. common failures: 401 from auth-proxy (x4), SchemaValidationError in toolcall handler (x6), streaming connection reset (x3). failing commit range: origin/main..origin/main~15. link: https://ci.internal/runs/2478001234 

jordan: pinging infra to rerun shard-2 and shard-4 first. sometimes reruns clear transient auth tokens. @ashok can you collect the first failing log lines? :eyes: 

ashok: grabbing logs now. pasted the top of shard-2 failure: 
```
E 10:42:11 auth: token exchange 401 kid not found
E 10:42:11 runtime: stream init failed: websocket closed before headers
E 10:42:12 toolcall: SchemaValidationError: missing required field 'tool_name' in tool invocation payload
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/tests/toolcall_test.py", line 78, in test_tool_invocation
    assert payload['tool_name']
KeyError: 'tool_name'
```

ashok: Hitting 401s with the kid rotation is suspicious — yesterday's deploy touched the auth-proxy key refresh logic.

samir: FYI I started a quick local run with `make integ-smoke` against staging-hosted and I can reproduce the SchemaValidationError reliably in the toolcall suite. looks like a stricter validator landed in middleware that now rejects the shorthand payloads our tests emit.

jordan: ok plan: 1) infra rerun shards 0-4 to rule out flakiness 2) ashok to bisect the last 15 commits for auth-proxy key refresh changes 3) samir to open a minimal revert/compatibility patch to relax the validator while we investigate 4) if reruns keep failing, temporarily skip the failing toolcall tests in nightly to unbreak main. who owns putting the skip?

ashok: I can run the bisect (will branch off ci-bisect/247800). can someone grant me permission to trigger parallel reruns? @ci-bot any quota notes?

ci-bot: quota ok. reruns requested: shards [0,1,2,3,4] queued by jordan. expected run time ~ 12m.

maria.p: thanks. ashok please post bisect commands/output here when you start. samir, can you draft the revert patch and tag it `wip/compat-toolcall-validator` so QE can validate quickly?

samir: will do. opening PR now, marking as draft. added test that demonstrates the old shorthand remains supported. :thumbsup:

ashok: starting bisect now: running binary search over origin/main~15..origin/main for commit that introduced auth-proxy key rotation change. will post results in ~20m. also attaching the local repro command I used: `KMS_ENV=staging make integ-smoke TEST_FILTER=toolcall`

jordan: reruns report: shard-2 passed on rerun, shard-4 still failing with same 401+schema combo. others pending. seems partially flaky.

ashok: bisect step 4 reproduced 401 consistently — commit `c8f3d9a` modifies auth-proxy key refresh timing. creating a PR to revert timing change to see if that clears 401s.

maria.p: great diagnostics. next actions: jordan/infra monitor reruns, ashok open revert PR for auth change, samir land the compatibility patch if tests confirm, QE will smoke the nightly after green. i'll update the incident doc and mark as high priority. tagging @oncall for visibility.

jordan: noted. if we need to skip tests, i'll coordinate the temporary skip and ensure it is tracked so we don't forget.

maria.p: closing coordination loop — thanks everyone, get it green and ping me when done. :white_check_mark:
